Poison (Ex)

Type poison (contact); save Fortitude DC 14; onset immediate; frequency 1/minute for 5 minutes ; cure 1 save 2d6 poi s on damage.

Alien Mind (Ex)

These creatures are immune to mi nd-affecting spells due to the completely alien nature of their minds.

Death Throes (Ex)

On death, the manshroom explodes in a thunderous boom. This causes 3d8 s oni c damage to all creatures in a 10-foot radius. A Fortitude save DC 14 is granted to reduce the damage to half.
